7800563.source: Local previously downloaded licensed Pexels demonstration file, inspected by development agent on 2026-11-07; not human approval

subject_relevance.evidence: The subject is isolated dental probes and scissors, not welcoming preventive care.

composition.evidence: Tools occupy only the lower half; the upper half is empty pale blue texture.

lighting.evidence: Soft even light, with clearly legible metallic tool edges.

color_harmony.evidence: Desaturated pale blue is visually quiet and compatible with a muted palette.

emotional_tone.evidence: Sharp clinical instruments may create anxiety rather than a reassuring first impression.

visual_clutter.evidence: Only a few instruments; no competing labels or background clutter.

hero_suitability.evidence: Enlarging this still life makes equipment dominate the visitor story.

mobile_cropping.evidence: A shallow landscape crop would remove the tool handles or show mostly empty background.

rejection_reasons: Clinical tool still life and large empty area undermine the preventive-care direction.

1279330.source: Local previously downloaded licensed Pexels demonstration file, inspected by development agent on 2026-11-07; not human approval

subject_relevance.evidence: The image visibly shows pasta, tomatoes and basil, matching the illustrative menu direction.

composition.evidence: The fork draws attention toward the pasta; central food remains readable in a split hero.

lighting.evidence: Soft highlights preserve texture in noodles and leaves without harsh glare.

color_harmony.evidence: Warm pasta and tomato colors work with terracotta; basil supplies a restrained green accent.

emotional_tone.evidence: Close food detail feels appetizing and informal.

visual_clutter.evidence: The plate and table form a quiet background around one food subject.

hero_suitability.evidence: Food can lead an illustrative restaurant hero with text kept on a contrasting surface.

mobile_cropping.evidence: A centered crop retains noodles and basil; the whole fork is not essential.

3993460.source: Local previously downloaded licensed Pexels demonstration file, inspected by development agent on 2026-11-07; not human approval

subject_relevance.evidence: A stylist holds scissors in a salon setting; appropriate as an explicitly illustrative craft image.

composition.evidence: The hand and scissors are sharply focused near center; the background is blurred.

lighting.evidence: Ambient light defines the hand and metal scissors without overwhelming highlights.

color_harmony.evidence: Muted brown, gray and dark tones sit comfortably beside rose or slate.

emotional_tone.evidence: The visible gesture conveys hair-styling craft; avoid implying this person works for the lead.

visual_clutter.evidence: Blurred overhead lights form shapes but do not obscure the main subject.

hero_suitability.evidence: The portrait supports an asymmetric split with text separate from the image.

mobile_cropping.evidence: A focal point at the central hand keeps the scissors visible in a shallow mobile crop.
